verdict.rationale: Stable markets automated check deposits and documents a Check object for transcribed checks. However, the evidence pack contains no published deposit terms: no list of supported banks, no per-deposit fee, no turnaround time, and nothing on what happens to the physical check after deposit. The story asks for published terms, so the existence of the feature alone does not deliver it.

support.subject: As a founder, check deposit terms are published — supported banks, per-deposit fees, turnaround time, and what happens to the physical check afterward
